mission: Create a music-led mythic ritual film in which an ancient fire-spirit awakens, gathers form, crosses sacred thresholds, reaches apotheosis, and resolves into transformed calm.

canon_lock.picture_language: Nocturnal ceremonial world of earth, fire, ash, smoke, dust, reflected light, sacred ruins/thresholds and a coherent mythic fire-spirit identity; internal world motion precedes camera motion.
items: Locked story: ancient fire-spirit awakened by ritual percussion and transformed through a nine-part arc.
No lyric literalism; musical structure, pulse, energy, tension and release drive visual development.
Central spirit identity remains coherent across forms and batches.
Ending resolves into transformation and elevated calm rather than destruction or horror.
